hero.headline: Reservations and booking – intelligent booking system

hero.headline: Connected building management with the BCM system
hero.intro: Security, comfort and digital information centrally controlled

bcm.label: BCM system
bcm.title: More than access control
bcm.text: The BCM system from TCS offers far more than just classic access control. It integrates a wide range of functions for modern, connected building management in a central, scalable software solution. Whether smart booking of communal rooms, smooth management of car parks or digital resident information – BCM efficiently combines these requirements and creates real added value for operators, employees and residents.

digitaleNamensanzeige.headline: 1. Digital name display
digitaleNamensanzeige.text: Central and contemporary management of resident data: with digital name management, resident or company names in residential and commercial buildings can be displayed in a modern way on display outdoor stations, floor buttons and letterboxes. Management is extremely convenient: via browser-based access, administrators can update the digital name plates remotely at any time, without having to be on site. At the letterboxes, the collection flap can also be fully integrated into the system and securely opened via electronic keys or PIN codes.

zufahrtssteuerung.headline: 2. Access control for driveways and car park monitoring
zufahrtssteuerung.text: Efficient parking management without waiting times: the system offers smooth access control for vehicles at barriers and gates – ideal for company driveways, logistics centres or employee car parks. Identification and opening are conveniently handled via intelligent licence plate recognition (even at speeds of up to 30 km/h), long-range UHF readers on the windscreen or copy-protected handheld transmitters. A special parking control unit also enables precise counting of vehicles in defined zones as well as the control of traffic light systems.

digitalSignage.headline: 3. Digital information and display systems (Digital Signage)
digitalSignage.text: Targeted communication via smart infoboards: whether in public authorities, companies, hotels or residential buildings: digital infoboards provide visitors, employees and residents with important information in a targeted way. These interactive display systems can be seamlessly integrated into the access control system and flexibly personalised. For example, opening hours, wayfinding plans, event calendars, weather data or important notices from the building management can be dynamically displayed on the screens.

reservierenBuchen.headline: 4. Reservation and booking
reservierenBuchen.text: Automated resource management including access authorisation: the BCM system includes an intelligent digital booking system that allows rooms, services or facilities such as laundries and sports halls to be conveniently reserved via smartphone, desktop PC or directly from applications such as Outlook. Particularly clever: the system grants access rights precisely for the selected time slot and, if required, also automatically opens upstream access points such as the main entrance or the car park barrier for the authorised user.

alarmanlagenkopplung.headline: 5. Alarm system integration
alarmanlagenkopplung.text: Connected security technology for optimal protection: for a holistic building security concept, BCM access control can be linked directly to existing intrusion and alarm systems. Users can conveniently arm or disarm the alarm system via interactions with the BCM readers or the smartphone app. Administrators can also define specific alarm zones and centrally monitor incoming alarm messages in the BCM software.
